# Fiora Velkbrook

Fiora Velkbrook currently serves as the Vertical Farm Operations Manager at Nexvane Networks, where she oversees multi-tower crop cycles and environmental monitoring within their PhytaTrack project. Since joining Nexvane in 2021, Fiora has played a key role in integrating sensor data with AI algorithms to optimize nutrient dosing schedules, directly contributing to improved crop yields and resource efficiency.

Prior to Nexvane, Fiora managed a pilot vertical farming facility, where she successfully scaled operations from 5 grow towers to 20 towers over two years (2018–2020). This expansion included implementation of precise atmospheric control systems and streamlined harvest logistics, which became foundational for her expertise in large-scale indoor agriculture environments.

Fiora’s specialties encompass nutrient dosing optimization, environmental sensor calibration, and crop cycle synchronization across multiple grow towers. She is known for her methodical working style—combining data-driven decision-making with hands-on adjustments on the farm floor.

In her role, Fiora collaborates closely with the R&D team developing AI models, the engineering group maintaining sensor networks, and the agronomists refining crop protocols. This cross-functional partnership ensures operational excellence and continuous innovation at Nexvane’s vertical farms.

Current employer: [[companies/nexvane-networks]].
